name: Sabo Kaikan Annex (Schönbach Sabo)
address: Tokyo 102-0093 Sabo Kaikan Annex, 2-7-4 Hirakawacho, Chiyoda-ku
accessSummary: Nagatacho Station (Tokyo Metro Yurakucho, Hanzomon and Namboku Lines) Exit 4: 1 min walk / Akasaka-mitsuke Station (Tokyo Metro Ginza and Marunouchi Lines): 8 min walk
hours: Conference rooms can be used 9:00-21:00 (also on Sat, Sun and holidays). Closed for the year-end/New Year period (December 28 to January 4). Reservations are accepted on weekdays 9:00-17:30.

rooms.name: Tone Main Conference Room (Tone Dai-Kaigishitsu)
rooms.note: 1F. Theater style 1,000 seats lengthwise / 930 seats widthwise; classroom style 624 seats lengthwise / 528 seats widthwise (the 2F gallery can be used for widthwise layouts). 2F gallery seating: 170 seats. The sliding wall divides the room into 2/3 and 1/3 sections (Kiso 209㎡ / Yodo 206㎡ / Shinano 213㎡; Yodo + Shinano 419㎡). Lift stage 12 x 4.5 m.

rooms.name: Kirishima
rooms.note: 3F. Up to 72 people. Hollow-square style 44 people (round tables).

ops.prevDaySetup: To secure time for preparing the audience seating, stage, lighting, sound and so on, a booking for the immediately preceding slot is requested for the 1F conference room. Usage time includes setup and cleanup time. When the room is used for 2 or more consecutive days, the full-day rate applies except for the last day. (Source: http://www.sabo.or.jp/kaikan-annnai/sabou-fin02/kaikan-annnai3.html)
ops.parking: Up to 4 vehicles can be parked free of charge for conference organizers. Ask the conference room staff. (Source: http://www.sabo.or.jp/kaikan-annnai/sabou-fin02/pdf/option.pdf)
ops.waitingRooms: As a waiting room for the Tone Main Conference Room, there is a waiting room on the 1F of the main building (26㎡, long-table style 14 people, can be divided in two with a movable partition). The waiting room (permanent, 1F) costs 16,500 yen per room (tax included, per day). (Source: http://www.sabo.or.jp/kaikan-annnai/sabou-fin02/kaikan-annnai3.html)
ops.catering: The venue can also be used for standing parties and meals. Catering can be discussed. (Source: http://www.sabo.or.jp/kaikan-annnai/sabou-fin02/kaikan-annnai3.html)
